title: Voyager 1 electrical power output, 1977 vs current
notes: Voyager 1's radioisotope thermoelectric generators (RTGs) produced 470 watts at launch in 1977. Output declines by roughly 4 watts a year as the onboard plutonium decays; by 2026 the craft was down to about 230 watts, forcing NASA to shut down science instruments one by one -- 8 of the original 10 are now off -- to keep the transmitter (and the signal) alive.
